items.information: Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley! * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors may only bring one guest maximum. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.information: Let op! We gaan bij deze wedstrijd iets langer door dan normaal. We verwachten om 21:00 klaar te zijn. Controleer het tijdschema goed bij het kiezen van je onderdelen. Als je eerder weggaat en je doet nog mee met een finale, vergeet je dan niet uit te schrijven bij de wedstrijdtafel. Attention! We will finish this competition later than normal. We expect to finish at 9 pm. Take a close look at the schedule when choosing your events. If you have to leave early and are still set to participate in a final, please inform the competition desk.
